title_lines: 美国中期选举聚焦数据中心扩张
超300地设限 电网与成本压力升温
两党角力 地方公投与行业前景待观察

subtitles.en: Few issues in the midterm elections bridged Americans partisan divide quite like opposition to data centers slow at first
subtitles.zh: 中期选举中，很少有议题能像反对数据中心那样弥合美国党派分歧，起初进展缓慢

subtitles.en: But then in what felt like an instant fervor has swelled over the massive build out to sustain the backbone of artificial intelligence Right now statistics show more than 300 localities have put construction moratoriums on data centers
subtitles.zh: 但随后几乎在一瞬间，围绕支撑人工智能基石的庞大建设热潮高涨。目前统计显示，超过300个地区已对数据中心实施建设禁令

subtitles.en: Some states are doing moratoriums some states are ushering them in but it's causing problems in the grid for a surrounding states What we need is a more than a national strategy and more holistic strategy
subtitles.zh: 一些州正在实施禁令，一些州则在引入，但这给周边州的电网带来了问题。我们需要的不只是国家战略，而是更全面的战略

subtitles.en: That was democratic congressman from virginia sujas supermanium and nationwide lawmakers on both sides of the aisle are working to contain The fallout over concerns with higher energy costs environmental risks and the impact on their host communities
subtitles.zh: 那是弗吉尼亚州民主党众议员苏贾斯·苏珀曼尼姆，全国两党议员都在努力控制因能源成本上升、环境风险及对所在社区影响的担忧而产生的后果
en_highlights: lawmakers on both sides of the aisle

subtitles.en: If I were a community, I would want the data center. It means Jobs it means income and it means lower taxes That's been the argument, but surveys show the sentiment isn't resonating
subtitles.zh: 如果我是社区，我会想要数据中心。它意味着就业、收入和更低的税收。这一直是论点，但调查显示这种情绪并未引起共鸣

subtitles.en: A september poll count 61% of voters say they oppose data center construction And right now voters are deciding on at least 35 data center related measures
subtitles.zh: 9月民调显示61%的选民表示反对数据中心建设。目前选民正在决定至少35项与数据中心相关的措施

subtitles.en: Including referendums on full bans zoning restrictions energy use and taxes one place grappling with what to do next is here in northern
subtitles.zh: 包括全面禁令、分区限制、能源使用和税收的公投。北弗吉尼亚州的一个地方正在努力应对下一步行动

subtitles.en: Virginia part of what's known as data center alley that includes loud and county where 233 facilities have either already been built or currently under construction
subtitles.zh: 弗吉尼亚州是所谓数据中心走廊的一部分，包括劳登县，那里已有233个设施建成或正在建设中

subtitles.en: But the area may soon press pause advancing a measure that would seek to halt the review of any new data center for up to 12 months
subtitles.zh: 但该地区可能很快暂停推进一项措施，该措施将寻求暂停任何新数据中心的审查长达12个月

clip_research.public_baseline: Public trackers confirm a large and growing wave of local data center moratoriums and restrictions across the US, with counts varying by methodology (300+ bills vs. 575+ restrictions).
clip_research.surprise_gap: The scale of local opposition (300+ moratoriums, 61% opposition) is striking given the industry's economic development pitch of jobs, income, and lower taxes.
